title: Feeling at home with audiences around the world
summary: A student asks how it feels to draw audiences everywhere; Armstrong says he thinks of himself as a neighborhood boy and first went to Sweden in 1934.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: How does it feel to be able to go all over the world and attract audiences? How does it, practically all this universe, how does it?

It got to feel good, because I don't look at it no different, same as another neighborhood boy, you know? Because when I get in all them countries, there's people there, and many just say, Satchmo, I think I'm in New York, or, you know?

And all you think about New York, I get back off the ship or something, you know? When you say, well it is, and I relax, and that's from the first time I went there in Sweden, 1934. Uh-huh. It's a long time.
